bio: Brandshatch Place Hotel is a sophisticated Georgian mansion, built in 1806, providing a unique setting to enjoy Afternoon Tea in Kent.  You can enjoy a traditional Afternoon tea including s peciality teas from Twining, a variety of delicate finger sandwiches, a selection of traditional cakes and pastries and of course, freshly baked scones with clotted cream and jam. To make the occasion extra special, why not add a glass of champagne?
